extension.summary: Watch statistics from your Jellyfin server
extension.description: Shows what you have watched on your Jellyfin server, including genre and rating. Browse watched movies and TV episodes, and view summary statistics such as genre breakdown and average ratings. Reuses the login from the Jellyfin for Kodi addon automatically, or connect with a server URL and API key.

extension.summary: Installs JellyStat and keeps it updated
extension.description: Add this repository once and Kodi updates JellyStat automatically whenever a new version is released.
